Where to Stay in Hua Hin / Prachuap?
12 Hotels We Actually Reviewed

heroSub: 12 hand-picked Hua Hin and Prachuap Khiri Khan hotels across every budget — from 5-star beachfront resorts at Khao Takiap down to a central Hua Hin hostel from ฿600/night. Covering the main areas: central Hua Hin, Khao Takiap, Pranburi, Khao Tao, Ban Krut and Prachuap Town. From roughly ฿600–16,000/night.
heroStats: 🏖️ 6 key areas (Central Hua Hin·Khao Takiap·Pranburi·Khao Tao·Ban Krut·Prachuap Town)
introH2: 🏖️ Why does choosing the right area in Hua Hin / Prachuap matter so much?
introHtml: Prachuap Khiri Khan is one of Thailand's longest provinces north to south, and Hua Hin is just its northern tip — each area has a completely different vibe. Central Hua Hin is the hub: beach, malls, the night market, the train station and accommodation at every price point, the easiest base to get around. Khao Takiap sits just south of town with a wider, quieter beach — the beachfront resort zone. Pranburi–Pak Nam Pran is about 30 minutes from Hua Hin, a calm boutique-resort area. Khao Tao is a tiny fishing village south of Hua Hin with a quiet beach. Ban Krut, in the Bang Saphan–Thap Sakae districts further south, has a genuinely long, quiet beach. And Prachuap Town, further south again, isn't a tourist hotspot but has a beautiful bay and cheap rooms. Many people book without checking the area, then lose hours driving back and forth. This guide rounds up 12 Hua Hin / Prachuap hotels we've already reviewed across every tier — with real guest-review scores, a 3-site price comparison and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Hua Hin and Prachuap have no metro. Getting around means your own car, rental car, scooter, taxi, or songthaew within central Hua Hin. From Bangkok it's about 2.5–3 hours by car, or you can take the train or a minivan. From Hua Hin south to Ban Krut–Bang Saphan is about 2 hours, and Prachuap Town about 1.5 hours. The areas in this guide: Central Hua Hin — beach, malls, night market, easy to get around · Khao Takiap — wider, quieter beach, ~10 min south of town · Pranburi — boutique resorts, ~30 min from Hua Hin · Khao Tao — quiet fishing-village beach · Ban Krut — long quiet beach, Bang Saphan–Thap Sakae · Prachuap Town — Prachuap Bay, cheap rooms.

entries.name: Hyatt Regency Hua Hin
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khao Takiap beachfront · ~10 min south of central Hua Hin

rooms.type: King Room with Pool Access (~46 sqm)

entries.addr: 91 Hua Hin - Khao Takiap Road, Nong Kae, Hua Hin
entries.storyHtml: The standout score and most-reviewed of the luxury picks — Hyatt Regency is a 5-star resort on Khao Takiap beach, spread low through wide tropical gardens with a roughly 300-metre private beach, scoring 9.3 from 311 reviews. Its heart is The Barai, a water-temple-style spa that many guests book here specifically to try. Real guest reviews praise the space, the leafy gardens, the varied breakfast and staff who remember your name — but note that Khao Takiap means a 10–15 minute drive into town, and some rooms show their age in a resort that's been open over 20 years.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're coming for The Barai, look at room packages that include the spa rather than paying separately, and book treatments ahead as they fill fast. Families with young kids should ask for a King Room with Pool Access — you step straight into the pool from the balcony.
pros: 9.3 from 311 reviews — the standout among the luxury picks
Wide ~300m private beach plus 3 outdoor pools in the gardens
The Barai spa is beautiful and well run — the resort's signature
Varied breakfast; friendly staff who remember guests' names
cons: Khao Takiap location means a 10–15 min drive into central Hua Hin
Some rooms show their age — the resort has been open 20+ years

entries.name: InterContinental Hua Hin Resort
entries.badge: 🛍️ Beachfront in town, walk to the mall
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Hua Hin beachfront · next to BlúPort mall
tags: 🏖️ Private beach in the heart of town
entries.storyHtml: InterContinental Hua Hin is a 5-star luxury resort sitting right on a private beach in the heart of Hua Hin, with a skybridge connecting straight into BlúPort mall, scoring 9.2 from 176 reviews. It's a location no other luxury resort in Hua Hin can match — want the sea, walk down to the beach; want food, cross the bridge to the mall. Guests get free entry to Vana Nava waterpark, and there's a kids club and two pools. Real guest reviews praise the location, breakfast and warm service, but flag that soundproofing between rooms isn't great.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Soundproofing is a known weak point — ask for a high floor or the quieter Beach Wing and note it on booking. Travelling as a family, set aside a half-day to use the free Vana Nava waterpark tickets that come with your stay.
pros: Private beach in the heart of town, skybridge into BlúPort mall
Free Vana Nava tickets, kids club and 2 pools — great for families
Varied breakfast; warm staff who look after children well
Clean private beach with fine white sand, easy to walk down to
cons: Soundproofing between rooms and from corridors isn't great
High-season prices are steep; Garden Wing rooms cross a bridge to the sea side

entries.name: Putahracsa Hua Hin Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Naebkehardt area · beachfront, central Hua Hin
tags: 🚶 Walk along the beach into town
entries.storyHtml: Putahracsa is a 5-star boutique beach resort in the Naebkehardt area, and the most-reviewed of the boutique picks with 343 reviews, scoring 9.0. It's beachfront yet still central, so you can walk along the sand into town. Rooms range from contemporary Urban Rooms in the main building to beachfront pool villas, suiting both couples and families. Real guest reviews praise the beachfront setting, design and easygoing service — a good fit for anyone who wants a beachfront boutique at a gentler price than the big chains.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For honeymooners or anyone wanting a private pool, look at the Oceanbed or La Canna pool villas right on the beach. Families should consider the Sansky Family Connecting Room, which links two rooms together.
pros: Most-reviewed boutique at 343 · steady 9.0 score
Beachfront in Naebkehardt, walk along the sand into town
Beachfront pool villas — great for couples and honeymooners
Contemporary design and easygoing service, under chain prices
cons: Urban Rooms in the main building lack direct sea views — pick your room type
Small resort — beachfront rooms sell out fast in high season

entries.name: Villa Maroc Resort Pranburi
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pak Nam Pran beachfront · ~30 min from Hua Hin
entries.addr: Pak Nam Pran · Pranburi · Prachuap Khiri Khan
entries.storyHtml: Villa Maroc is a Moroccan-themed boutique resort on Pak Nam Pran beach, and the highest-scoring hotel in this guide at 9.5. Its draw is the curved white-and-blue Moroccan architecture you won't find elsewhere around here, a calm and private setting that suits couples and photographers. Real guest reviews praise the design, the quiet and the warm small-resort service. Worth knowing: it has relatively few reviews (41) as a small property, and Pak Nam Pran is about 30 minutes from Hua Hin, so a car helps.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pak Nam Pran is quiet with restaurants spread out, so a car helps for meals and trips to Pranburi Forest Park. For a sea view, choose the Deluxe Seascape or a beachfront villa.
pros: Highest score in the guide at 9.5 — distinctive Moroccan design
Pak Nam Pran beachfront, quiet and private
Great for couples, honeymoons and photographers
Warm small-resort service, with a spa
cons: Few reviews (41) as a small property
Pak Nam Pran is ~30 min from Hua Hin — a car helps

entries.name: Anantara Hua Hin Resort

rooms.type: Club Two Bedroom Family Pool Suite

tags: 🌴 Lush tropical gardens by the sea
entries.storyHtml: Anantara Hua Hin is the very first Anantara resort, opened in 2001 and given a major renovation in 2025, scoring 9.0 from 164 reviews. Its charm is a dense tropical garden, grown over more than 20 years until it feels like a small jungle in the middle of Hua Hin. There's a kids club, tennis courts and a small animal farm where children can feed the animals. Real guest reviews praise the garden atmosphere, service and food — but note most rooms face the garden rather than the open sea, and there are insects in the gardens, as you'd expect.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling with family, choose a Lagoon-zone room or a Family Pool Suite, closest to the pool and kids club. Book in June or September — Hua Hin's low season — for the cheapest rates.
pros: Lush tropical gardens — feels like a jungle in the middle of town
Family-friendly: kids club, plenty of activities, a small animal farm
Attentive service, recognised guests; good Anantara dining and spa
Beachfront central Hua Hin, walking distance to the night market
cons: Most rooms are garden-view, not full sea views
Peak and long-weekend prices are high; natural garden insects

entries.name: Sirarun Resort Ban Krut
entries.badge: 💬 Many reviews, best value at Ban Krut
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Krut beach · Ang Thong, Thap Sakae
entries.addr: Ang Thong · Thap Sakae · Prachuap Khiri Khan
entries.storyHtml: Sirarun is a beachfront villa resort at Ban Krut with as many as 553 reviews and a high 9.2 score on both Trip.com and Booking. It sits on the long, quiet Ban Krut beach in the south of the province, well away from the bustle of Hua Hin. Rooms are villa-style, from garden views to beachfront pool villas. Real guest reviews praise the quiet, the clean beach and the value — ideal for escaping the crowds for a genuinely beachside stay. Worth knowing: it's far, so a car helps and it pays to stay a few nights.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ban Krut is about 2 hours from Hua Hin, so bring a car and stay multiple nights. To wake up and walk straight onto the sand, pick a beachfront Pool Villa.
pros: 553 reviews · steady 9.2 score on both sites
Long, quiet Ban Krut beachfront with a clean beach
Beachfront pool villas with a private villa feel
Good value for a beachfront villa resort
cons: About 2 hours from Hua Hin — bring a car, stay a few nights
Limited restaurants and entertainment around the resort

entries.name: Kao Tao Villa Beach Resort
entries.badge: 🌊 Quiet Khao Tao beach, good value
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khao Tao beach · ~14 km from Hua Hin
entries.addr: Khao Tao Beach · Nong Kae · Hua Hin
entries.storyHtml: Kao Tao Villa is a guesthouse-style beach resort on Khao Tao beach, a small fishing village about 14 km south of Hua Hin, scoring 8.9 from 299 reviews. Its draw is Khao Tao beach, far quieter than Hua Hin, from just ฿1,800. Rooms range from budget Eco Zone up to sea-view poolside villas. Real guest reviews praise the quiet, the laid-back beachside feel and the value — good for anyone who wants a restful base near Hua Hin without paying premium prices.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Khao Tao is a small fishing village with cheap, fresh seafood spots. For a sea view, the Family Room Sea View or a Poolside Villa step up the price only a little.
pros: Khao Tao beach is far quieter than Hua Hin, from ฿1,800
Relaxed, friendly guesthouse-by-the-sea atmosphere
Sea-view poolside villas at an accessible price
Near Khao Tao fishing village with cheap fresh seafood
cons: Outside central Hua Hin — you need a car to get into town
Budget Eco Zone rooms have no sea view — choose your room type

entries.name: Prachuap Grand Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Sala Chip Rd · Prachuap Town · ~5 min walk to the sea
entries.addr: Sala Chip Road · Prachuap Khiri Khan Town
entries.storyHtml: Prachuap Grand is the best-value choice in Prachuap Town, from just ฿1,200 with a 9.0 score. It's on Sala Chip Road in the town centre, about a 5-minute walk to Prachuap Bay and the markets. Higher rooms look out over the bay and Khao Chong Krachok hill. Real guest reviews praise the cleanliness, central location and value — ideal for a stopover or for visiting Prachuap Bay and Khao Chong Krachok without paying much. Worth knowing: Prachuap Town isn't a buzzing tourist hub like Hua Hin.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a bay view, ask for a Sea Sky Suite or a high floor. Climb Khao Chong Krachok early for the bay view (watch the monkeys), then come back for fresh seafood in town.
pros: Best value in Prachuap Town, from just ฿1,200 with a 9.0 score
Central, ~5 min walk to Prachuap Bay and the markets
Some rooms have views of Prachuap Bay and Khao Chong Krachok
Clean — good for a stopover or visiting Prachuap Bay on a budget
cons: Prachuap Town isn't a lively tourist hub like Hua Hin
A city hotel, not a beach resort you can step into the sea from

entries.name: Cape Nidhra Hotel Hua Hin
entries.badge: 🏊 Every room has a private pool
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Beachfront · central Hua Hin · walk to Market Village
tags: 🏊 All-suite, every room has a private pool
entries.storyHtml: Cape Nidhra is a beachfront boutique hotel in central Hua Hin where every room is a suite with its own private pool, scoring 8.5 from 100 reviews. The all-suite, private-pool concept is rare in a central beachfront location and suits couples wanting privacy. It's walking distance to Market Village mall and the beach. Real guest reviews praise the in-room private pools and the location, but the score sits below the top resorts here because some reviews note inconsistent service and the condition of certain rooms — hence this ranking.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The selling point is the in-room private pool — a higher-floor suite gets you more privacy and a better view. A small family can look at the larger Family Pool Suite.
pros: Every room is a suite with a private pool — rare in this location
Beachfront central Hua Hin, walk to Market Village and the beach
Great for couples wanting privacy
Small boutique design, quieter than a big resort
cons: 8.5 score sits below the top 5-star resorts in this guide
Some reviews note inconsistent service and room condition

entries.name: Veranda Lodge Hua Hin
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Beachfront · south Hua Hin, toward Khao Takiap
entries.storyHtml: Veranda Lodge is a beachfront boutique lodge with the most reviews in this guide — over 1,629, scoring 8.3. It sits on the south Hua Hin beach heading toward Khao Takiap, a compact resort with both block rooms and garden bungalows, some steps from the sand. Real guest reviews praise the beachfront location and value for a seafront resort, though some note that rooms and facilities are showing their age — which keeps the score and this ranking modest. A fit for anyone prioritising a beachfront spot at a mid-range budget over newness.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To wake up and walk onto the sand, choose Veranda on Sea, closest to the beach. Check the room on arrival and ask to change if needed — rooms here vary.
pros: Most-reviewed in the guide at 1,629 — a big base of real guests
On the south Hua Hin beach; some rooms step onto the sand
Both block rooms and garden bungalows, leafy setting
Beachfront boutique at an accessible price, from ฿2,800
cons: 8.3 score — some rooms and facilities show their age
Rooms vary; check the condition on check-in

entries.name: Ban Krut Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Krut beach · Thong Chai, Bang Saphan
entries.addr: Thong Chai · Bang Saphan · Prachuap Khiri Khan
entries.storyHtml: Ban Krut Resort is the cheapest beachfront option in this guide — from just ฿1,100, scoring 8.9. It sits on the quiet Ban Krut beach in Bang Saphan district, in the south of the province. Rooms are guesthouse-style, from Triple/Quad rooms for groups up to villas. Real guest reviews praise the quiet, the clean beach and the very low price for a seafront spot. Worth knowing: it has few reviews (42), it's far, and it's a simple stay rather than a luxury resort — best for budget travellers who just want to sleep by a quiet sea.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ban Krut is far from Hua Hin, so bring a car. Groups and families split the Triple/Quad rooms or a villa cheaply — just don't expect luxury-resort service.
pros: Cheapest beachfront in the guide, from just ฿1,100
Quiet, clean, private Ban Krut beach
Triple/Quad family rooms and villas — cheap per person
Good for budget travellers who want a quiet seaside sleep
cons: Few reviews (42); far from Hua Hin — bring a car
A simple stay, not a luxury resort — basic service

entries.name: Sunshine Hostel Hua Hin
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Hua Hin 92 · central Hua Hin · ~5 min walk to the sea
entries.storyHtml: Sunshine Hostel is the cheapest stay in this guide — from just ฿600, yet scoring a high 9.3. It's on Soi Hua Hin 92 in the town centre, about a 5-minute walk to the beach and markets. It's a small guesthouse-style place, with simple rooms from a windowless Budget Double up to a Standard King with a balcony. Real guest reviews praise the cleanliness, the friendly owner, the central location and the value. A great fit for backpackers and budget travellers using Hua Hin as a base who don't need luxury amenities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The cheapest Budget room has no window — for natural light and a balcony, step up to the Standard King. It's a small place with limited rooms, so book ahead on weekends.
pros: Cheapest in the guide, from just ฿600 · high 9.3 score
Central Hua Hin, ~5 min walk to the sea and markets
Clean, with a friendly owner and a guesthouse feel
Excellent value for backpackers using town as a base
cons: The cheapest Budget room has no window
Small place, limited rooms, no luxury amenities

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Hua Hin / Prachuap hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in around Hua Hin / Prachuap?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style. Central Hua Hin is the hub — beach, malls, night market, easiest to get around (InterContinental, Anantara, Putahracsa, Cape Nidhra, Sunshine). Khao Takiap has a wider, quieter beach just south of town (Hyatt Regency, Veranda). Pranburi is a calm boutique-resort area (Villa Maroc). Khao Tao is a quiet fishing-village beach (Kao Tao Villa). Ban Krut is a long, quiet southern beach (Sirarun, Ban Krut Resort). And Prachuap Town is cheap with a beautiful bay (Prachuap Grand).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Hua Hin / Prachuap hotels cost?
faq.a: There's a wide range: hostels and budget stays start around ฿600–1,200 a night; mid-range resorts and hotels up to 4-star run about ฿1,800–4,800; 5-star beachfront resorts and boutiques start around ฿4,500–6,500+, with sea-view rooms and pool villas higher again. All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms; high season (Nov–Feb) and long weekends run well above normal.

faq.q: ❓ How do Hua Hin, Ban Krut and Prachuap Town differ?
faq.a: Hua Hin is at the northern tip of the province, a lively resort town with beaches, malls, restaurants and accommodation at every tier, and it's closest to Bangkok (2.5–3 hours). Ban Krut, in Bang Saphan–Thap Sakae, is about 2 hours further south with a genuinely long, quiet beach — good for escaping the crowds (Sirarun, Ban Krut Resort). Prachuap Town, mid-province, has the scenic Prachuap Bay and Khao Chong Krachok and cheap rooms, but isn't a buzzing tourist hub (Prachuap Grand).

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Hua Hin / Prachuap hotel?
faq.a: On weekdays outside the tourist season, 2–4 weeks ahead is fine. But in high season (November–February), and especially on long weekends, New Year and Songkran, good rooms and beachfront resorts in Hua Hin fill up fast — book 1–2 months ahead or more, since Hua Hin is a top weekend escape for Bangkok residents.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Hua Hin / Prachuap, and do I need a car?
faq.a: Bangkok to Hua Hin is about 2.5–3 hours by car, minivan or train. Within central Hua Hin there are songthaews and motorbike taxis, which work fine. But if you're staying at Khao Takiap, Pranburi, Khao Tao, or further south at Ban Krut or Prachuap Town, having a car is much more convenient, as distances are long and public transport is limited.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Hua Hin / Prachuap hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by promotion at different times — we recommend opening all three and comparing before every booking. Each review page in this guide has price-comparison links, which can save you several hundred to over a thousand baht a night during peak periods.
